strings.#30:
SATORI (tm)  uses a technique called "color animation" which changes the colors of an image without having to redraw the image.  This happens only if your system has 256 colors.  If your system does not have 256 colors then a single frame of the Satori light show is built.

If your machine is in 256 colors:
Pressing CAPS LOCK key will change your palette, so that you can flip through different palettes without waking After Dark.

Try the "Mix" display option -- it is well worth the wait.

Original design and concept by Ben Haller.
